_source: findings/24_shared_libs_proto.md:26-96,140-219 (goutils/passport v3/v4 claim structs, GetLegacyAuthType decision table). Header: X-Passport-JWT-V1. Payouts uses v3 (static pubkey-per-kid, config keys passport.api.identifier="apiv1", passport.edge.identifier="edgev1"/"edgev2").
_note_on_impersonation_bug: ImpersonationClaims has NO json tags in the real struct (upstream bug) -- wire keys are literally 'Type'/'Consumer' (capitalized), not 'type'/'consumer'. Reproduced faithfully below for M3's proxy tokens.

signing.algorithm: RS256 (assumed -- goutils/passport is JWT-standard; arena mints its own JWKS/keypair per findings/29_env2_scaffold.md dcs-stub precedent of grounding in real repo contracts). TODO(confirm): exact algorithm not independently re-verified against goutils/passport signer code in this pass -- findings/24 confirms claim shape and header name, not the signing algorithm.

private_mode_tokens._description: M1 and M2 API-key merchants -- straight merchant auth, no impersonation, no oauth.

proxy_impersonation_tokens._description: M3 finance users (dashboard impersonation) -- identified/authenticated as the human user, with an Impersonation block naming the merchant being acted on. roles carries the RazorpayX finance role name.

internal_service_tokens._description: Not passport JWTs -- internal service-to-service calls (FTS webhook, workflow callbacks, monolith relay) use HTTP Basic auth per findings/13_fts_payouts_status_path.md finding #1: middleware.BasicAuth(cred.API, cred.Workflow, cred.Xperience, cred.FTS, cred.VendorPayments, cred.Settlements, cred.Irctc). See README.md for the arena's synthetic Basic-Auth credential pairs (payouts_key, fts_key, x_balances_key, etc, per BOM Sec 1).

authz_role_bundle_note: finance_l1/finance_l2/owner (M3) mirror the BOM Sec 4 role set (finance_l1/l2/l3/owner/view_only). AuthZ policy enforcement itself is BLOCKED_BY_FIDELITY_GAP per BOM Sec 4/8 -- the passport claim shape above is sufficient to exercise PS-side role-based branching (if any exists in payouts code), but real per-route authorization decisions live in the unreadable authz/api-monolith repos and cannot be fixture-verified end-to-end in this arena.
